notes: No public vendor STL, GLB, STEP, or other directly reusable 3D model for the Tecan Resolvex A200 was located during web search.

The visual mesh is therefore a segmented fallback built from official envelope dimensions and official product imagery so the instrument remains recognizable as an open-front positive-pressure workstation.
Front-loading, rack, touchscreen, and rear-service positions are integration-oriented estimates and should not be treated as factory metrology.
